# CANDIDATE: ENABLE_SHOTGUN_SCALPER_FOR_TBR_HIGH_VOL

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** watcher_proposal
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Enabling the SHOTGUN_SCALPER watcher (associated with TBR_HIGH_VOL candidate) will allow the engine to take trades on TRENDLINE_BREAK_RETEST signals with volume >= 1.5x 20-bar average. Backtest shows OOS expectancy of +$2.07/trade but with high concentration risk in specific regimes (Q2-2025 IS and Q1-2026 OOS >80% of P&L). The edge may not be robust across all market conditions.

## Mechanism

The SHOTGUN_SCALPER watcher currently logs TRENDLINE_BREAK_RETEST signals with volume filter but does not trigger entries (WATCH-ONLY). Enabling it would change the watcher to return an actionable signal. The engine would then use the standard BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON management logic (chart stop as primary invalidation, chandelier profit-lock at +5%/trail15%, TP1 at +50% for 2/3 qty, runner exit rules) upon signal fire. Exact entry/contract selection parameters (strike, DTE) would need to be defined; assuming ITM-2 0DTE puts based on candidate's note that ITM-2 stop=-35% is needed for real-fills validity.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account for full headline P&L; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline due to 50% per-trade risk cap.
2. **Sample bias:** Tested on 16-month SPY 5m data (IS N=332, OOS N=239). High concentration: IS Q2-2025=85.4% of P&L from top 5 days; OOS Q1-2026=90.6% of P&L from top 5 days. Significant overfit risk; edge may be regime-dependent.
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS N=239 trades, WR=60.7%, expectancy=+$2.07/trade, IS/OOS ratio=0.866 (from candidate TBR_HIGH_VOL WF PASS line).
4. **Real-fills:** ATM real-fills test failed (all 6 quarters negative). ITM-2 stop=-35% needed for validity (per candidate). NEEDS-REAL-FILLS for ITM-2 configuration.
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: unknown without per-day P&L breakdown.
   - Max drawdown: unknown without equity curve.
   - Blow-up scenario: In low-volume regimes, volume filter may produce false signals leading to consecutive losses; concentration risk means ~90% of OOS P&L comes from ~5% of days, leaving ordinary days near-breakeven or negative.
6. **Concentration:** IS top-5 days = 85.4% of P&L; OOS top-5 days = 90.6% of P&L (explicitly called out in candidate as concentration flag >80% gate).
